[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 30
- Description: fix(roda): Start/End Roda Session now control audio
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/capoeira/pull/41
  
  Details:
  Diagnosis: on capoeira.agroverse.shop/roda.html the Start/End Roda Session buttons only drove session logging + timer, never audio transport. Boot autoplay attempt in loadCurrent() is blocked by browsers (no user gesture), so Start never started the berimbau music; endRodaSession() never paused audio, so music kept playing after End. Reported by Nobody Will.
  
  Fix (PR #41, merged): added els.audio.play().catch() inside startRodaSession() (runs inside the click user-gesture, so autoplay is allowed; track src already set by boot loadCurrent()) and els.audio.pause() in endRodaSession(). Session-logging pipeline (localStorage resume, Edgar practice-session submit, track dedupe) untouched.
  
  Verification: live capoeira.agroverse.shop/roda.html confirmed byte-identical to repo main before edit; post-merge headless-Chromium click test with default autoplay blocking: INITIAL paused=true, AFTER START paused=false + currentTime advancing, AFTER END paused=true + currentTime frozen; zero page errors.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 0
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
